The playable game is the unminified HTML page, not the QR-sized
aggressive minify. Google Analytics is stripped. The 4.7 MB
Game-Music.mp3 is not packed — the QR edition never carried it.

GifOS adds pointer lock, a Continue for the best score, analog
thumb look/move, and extra bodies over an invite. Upstream has
no save and no networking.

The notice travels INSIDE the GIF as well as beside it here.
